numbers.what: no vector rejects a non-finite value in every numeric field

durations.what: strict grammar (no 1e3d, +5d, .5d, 5.d) and ISO 8601 durations not yet in vectors or fid

timestamps.what: no vector for rounding at exactly .5 ms

temporal.what: no vector combines an echo with a shape or a fast share

structure.what: no vector rejects a third top-level member

envelope-fields.what: no vectors for missing fields, out-of-range or mistyped values
null half-life must answer UNKNOWN, ext, I-JSON content: not in fid; the vector 'no half-life never decays' pins the old behaviour

stamping.what: derived-stamp rules tested only by Rust unit tests, no vectors

versioning.what: unknown versions and members not yet answered UNKNOWN

check.what: UNKNOWN for a null half-life or an unknown member not implemented

half-life-registry.what: whole-state lookup not implemented (a test pins inheritance); no vectors

calibrator.what: row-order invariance and maximum-likelihood estimation not implemented

reference-procedure.what: fits are least squares, not maximum likelihood; ties in bins follow row order

conformance.what: every MUST has a vector or a listed gap

security.exempt: a rule for consumers of envelopes, not testable in fid
security.what: authenticity by other means; no monotonic decay assumed with an echo
no test that scoring work is bounded on the longest-period, narrowest-width curve

privacy.exempt: guidance for producers of ledgers, not testable in fid
privacy.what: pseudonymize entity names; treat per-entity output as personal data
